summary: Snohomish County, WA L-4 cab built on the site in the 1930s; later abandoned and gone, with no source describing remains or visitor access.

facts.status_note: Register and Firelookout.com say the cab was abandoned and is gone; WillhiteWeb has never been shown remains

visit.trail_note: WillhiteWeb: no trail exists from Canyon Lake; access roads are good gravel

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register and Firelookout.com say abandoned; Forest Lookouts says removed. All sources agree the cab is gone, so the story says the sources differ on how it ended.

notes_for_editor: The site is gone and every source agrees on that, but none describes remains or whether the site is open to visitors, so facts.access is left out. The sources give only the 1930s for the build, so events leave out the year rather than guess. Used 1 WebSearch and 6 page reads. The FFLOS page lists the registry date as February 12, 2020, which matches the brief. The Forest Lookouts page is the only source that says removed.
